resources.string: This app needs camera access to capture and process video frames in real-time. Camera access is essential for the core functionality of the application.
Camera permission was denied. The app cannot function without camera access. Please grant camera permission in Settings.
Camera permission was permanently denied. Please enable camera permission in Settings > Apps > %s > Permissions.
Android 10 provides enhanced camera privacy controls. You can manage camera access for this app in your device settings at any time.
Camera preview showing real-time video feed with OpenCV processing
Toggle button to show or hide camera preview. Camera processing continues in background when hidden.
Rotate camera display by 90 degrees clockwise. Cycles through 0, 90, 180, and 270 degrees.
Select image processing mode. Options include passthrough, grayscale, edge detection, color spaces, blur, and sharpen.
Toggle performance metrics overlay showing FPS, processing time, memory usage, and frame drops
